resolutionLimitations: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 country map units include territories and disputed units; 258 source features are not a count of sovereign states, cities or playable destinations.
Boundaries reflect this immutable Natural Earth release and default de facto policy; source-coordinate checks do not establish complete polygon topology or spherical validity.

The raw 10m pin is retained for bounded representation work; Russia, United States, Canada and Antarctica exceed the current 512000-byte outline asset limit and are not silently omitted or published through the legacy reader.
